name: Delay Show Results
purpose: Keystroke debounce for the address picker: depending on the session address provider (SmartyStreets or Google Places) installs a 0.75 second OnTimer that runs the matching "Get ... Address Suggestions" script, replacing any pending timer so the search runs only when typing pauses.
calls:
Install OnTimer Script target: Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/117 "Get Smarty Street Address Suggestions" (step 6)
Install OnTimer Script target: Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/198 "Get Google Places Address Suggestions" (step 8)
open_question: The delay (0.75 s) is a magic number. Provider is read from Picker::AddressServiceProviderThisSession (global); neither provider matching leaves the timer unset.

name: Get Smarty Street Address Suggestions
purpose: Calls the SmartyStreets US autocomplete suggest API with the text typed in the picker search field and the stored SmartyStreets auth id and token (via "HTTP ( {request} )"), stores the JSON response and the list of suggestion texts in Picker globals, and either constrains the picker to the matches or restores the cursor in the search field when there are none. Cancels any pending OnTimer first and does nothing for an empty search.

open_question: secret: step 42-43 read Picker::SmartyStreets_AuthToken#18 and SmartyStreets_AuthId#17 (stored fields) and step 61 sends them as query parameters auth-token and auth-id; the target must keep them out of code. Cancels any pending OnTimer first and does nothing for an empty search.

open_question: secret: step 37 reads Picker::GooglePlaces_ApiKey#23 (a stored field) and step 55 sends it as query "key"; the target must keep it out of code. Header comment says "Gets address suggestions from Smarty Streets" but this script uses Google Places.

name: Select Google Place Address
purpose: Resolves the address the user picked from the Google Places suggestions: reads the place id from the selected row (record number - 1) of Picker::AddressSuggestions, fetches the Google place details, extracts street number, route, subpremise, floor, city, county, state, country and postal code, and re-checks the street, city and state against SmartyStreets US street verification (retrying with the Google neighborhood when no match). Returns a standard address object (AddressCount, AddressArray[0] line1/line2/city/county/postal code/state, phone, name, website) in Picker::Results and closes the picker window.
external:
Perform Script HTTP ( {request} ) (Picker_Module scripts/115, step 17): GET https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/details/json
Perform Script HTTP ( {request} ) (Picker_Module scripts/115, steps 56, 67): GET https://us-street.api.smartystreets.com/street-address
open_question: secret: step 12 reads Picker::GooglePlaces_ApiKey#23 and step 15 sends it as query "key"; step 49 reads Picker::SmartyStreets_AuthId#17 and SmartyStreets_AuthToken#18 and sends them as auth-id and auth-token. The returned address comes only from SmartyStreets data ($body[0]), so when AddressCount is 0 after both attempts the AddressLine1, City, etc. are empty. Selected row is taken from Get(RecordNumber) of the current found set (relies on the picker portal row order). PostalCode is zipcode & "-" & plus4_code even when plus4_code is empty. Country (short_name) is extracted but not returned.

name: Select Smarty Street Address
purpose: Resolves the address the user picked from the SmartyStreets suggestions: takes the city, state and street line of the selected row (record number - 1) of Picker::AddressSuggestions, verifies it with the SmartyStreets US street verification API, and returns a standard address object (AddressCount, AddressArray[0]) in Picker::Results and closes the picker window.
external: Perform Script HTTP ( {request} ) (Picker_Module scripts/115, step 22): GET https://us-street.api.smartystreets.com/street-address
open_question: secret: step 15 reads Picker::SmartyStreets_AuthId#17 and SmartyStreets_AuthToken#18 and sends them as auth-id and auth-token. PostalCode is zipcode & "-" & plus4_code even when plus4_code is empty. Selected row is taken from Get(RecordNumber) of the current found set.

name: Dispatch Address Search
purpose: Runs the address search when the picker search field is not empty: dispatches to "Get Smarty Street Address Suggestions" or "Get Google Places Address Suggestions" according to the session provider.
calls:
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/117 "Get Smarty Street Address Suggestions" (step 3)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/198 "Get Google Places Address Suggestions" (step 5)

name: Constrain to Found
purpose: Narrows the address picker result list to the number of suggestions found: sets the Picker::FoundCount label text ("Found N address(es)" with a note when N = 10), enters find mode and finds VirtualListAddressPicker rows with n <= foundCount, goes to the first record and runs "Go to Picker Button".
open_question: Step 3 (Refresh Object foundCount) is disabled. The find uses a virtual-list table (VirtualListAddressPicker) whose n field is the row index. The 10 result cap is stated in the label only; the cap itself is enforced by the provider API.
